prose.name: Security: Relay Alignment on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The relay at the <Place> has lost its transmitter, and a replacement was dropped at the site. Fitting it will make noise, and noise out here brings company.

beats.journal: The relay dish is fitted, but it has to align before it can lock on, and the noise has drawn attention. I need to hold until it's done.
beats.name: Relay Dish
beats.say: Great, that's aligning now. Keep an eye out.

beats.journal: I fitted the relay at the <Place> and held off three waves of attackers while it aligned. The relay is live.
beats.say: Link is online. Thanks for your help.

broadcast: We've lost a relay down there. The replacement transmitter is at the site. Fit it to the dish and stay with it while it aligns. It will be loud, and loud draws company.
